name: ShowAndTell v1 · Comprehension (AEI)
protocol: Official v1 quiz protocol; excludes preliminary non-canonical workbook grades and does not represent full AEI learning or execution.

summary.en: Tests understanding of a business workflow after a demonstration; not the full Agent Effectiveness Index.
summary.zh: 测试看过演示后对业务流程的理解，不代表完整 Agent Effectiveness Index。

task_format.en: Teach by demonstration, then answer questions about the learned workflow. Current public evidence is a preliminary 24-shared-case workbook snapshot.
task_format.zh: 通过演示教学，再回答关于所学流程的问题。目前公开证据是包含 24 个共同案例的初步工作簿快照。

explanation.en: Canonical quiz scoring averages question scores. Published shared-case workbook grades mix manual and model-assisted grading, so they are auxiliary only; incomplete attempts count zero, untested cells are excluded, cases receive equal weight.
explanation.zh: 主协议按题目分数取平均。公开共同案例成绩混用人工和模型评分，因此仅作辅助证据；未完成运行得零分，未测试项不计入，各案例等权。
